first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and the archived evidence suggests that shortening onboarding can improve time-to-value while activation messaging can support first meaningful action. I would verify both records, then run a guarded onboarding simplification test focused on self-serve accounts, monitoring qualified pipeline, retention, and activation quality—not just completion rate. This addresses an immediate funnel constraint without broadly matching the competitor’s potentially unsustainable pricing.
